svg.text: 1. RECONSTRUCTED FROM 22 PANORAMIC PHOTOGRAPHS. NO SITE SURVEY HAS BEEN CARRIED OUT.
2. NO DIMENSION ON THIS DRAWING IS VERIFIED. ALL ARE DERIVED, ESTIMATED OR ASSUMED.
4. WALL THICKNESSES AND ALL STRUCTURAL ELEMENTS: NOT VERIFIED FROM PHOTOGRAPHS.
5. DO NOT SCALE. DO NOT BUILD FROM THIS DRAWING WITHOUT ON-SITE VERIFICATION.
6. PRESENTATION VIEW. THE UNDERLYING MODEL IS NOT MODIFIED:
THE CEILING AND THE CUT WALL PORTIONS REMAIN AS EDITABLE OBJECTS.
7. SEE A-001 FOR THE FLOOR PLAN AT THE SAME SCALE.
